- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Bell Tower: A four-story wooden tower located in the city center; visitors can admire views from the top for free.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Drum Tower: Located near the Bell Tower; visitors can climb to the top for free to enjoy views of the city.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Xi'an City Wall: One of the best-preserved city walls in China; visitors can walk or bike along the wall for free.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Muslim Quarter: A lively area with shops, restaurants, and markets; visitors can explore this area for free.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Small Wild Goose Pagoda: A 13-story brick tower; visitors can enter the grounds for free, but there is a fee to enter the pagoda.

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Terracotta Warriors: A collection of sculptures depicting the armies of the first Emperor of China; a must-visit site.

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Huaqing Hot Springs: A scenic area famous for hot springs and beautiful gardens; visitors can enjoy the scenery and learn about the area's history.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Tang Paradise: An amusement park showcasing the culture and history of the Tang Dynasty with attractions like a musical fountain show and cultural performances.
